Third-Year at U.A..name: Third-Year at U.A.
Third-Year at U.A..description: 🎓 You are a third-year at U.A. Academy: the senior students, the ones the younger years watch.
Third-Year at U.A..traitNarrativeEffects: Since April of the third year the character and everyone who entered U.A. with them are third-years, the academy's senior class (Class 1-A is now Class 3-A, 1-B is 3-B). Never call the character or their classmates first-years or second-years.
